raw_segments.text: Ye go, I do not know. Friends all but now, even now in quarter, and in terms like bride
and groom divesting them for bed. And then, but now, as if some planet had unwitted men,
swords out, and tilting one at others breast, in opposition bloody. I cannot speak any beginning
to this peevish odds, and would in action glorious I had lost those legs that brought
me to a part of it.
